description: Defines an interface for building responses and events related to modifying feature properties in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for modify feature properties commands.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects related to feature properties.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by modify feature properties commands.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating feature properties were created.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating feature properties were modified.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotAccessibleError
